concept.title: Carers and families
concept.shortdesc: Parents, carers, young carers and family or friends who look after someone, including parents of children with special needs.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People aged roughly 50 or 60 and over, or described as older or elderly, including older women and men.
: Parents, grandparents, carers and childminders looking after children.
: Children, teenagers and young adults who look after a family member, and their families.
: Relatives, friends and carers who support someone, named together as a group.
: People who provide unpaid care or support to a relative or friend, including former and foster carers, sometimes alongside the person they care for.
: Parents and carers of disabled children or children with special educational needs, including autism and ADHD.
